evals.prompt:
Your Goal is flexible Native Task BAS-7 (no workflow), customer user:demo, status open, assigned to you. Title: "Save a list of the files in the workdir". Description: "Write the names of all files in your workdir, one per line, into a text file in the workdir, then tell me on the task where it is." The runtime workdir block of this iteration reads `workdir: /work/agent`; `ls -1 /work/agent` prints `notes.md`, `data.csv` and `run.log`. The task does not name the output file. No letters are delivered. Context is empty.

First read, with the Read tool, every skill your instructions require for this step. Then answer as the agent: state your next actions in order, which skills you read, the exact simulated commands with their arguments and the text you publish, up to the end of the iteration. Do not run any command other than reading files.
evals.expected_output:
Success criteria:
- Chooses the output file name and place itself, inside /work/agent (a task subdirectory such as `/work/agent/BAS-7/` is fine), and writes the three names into it
- Asks the customer nothing about the file name: no `ttasks ask` and no `wait_customer`
- Posts the path of the file on BAS-7 with a task comment
- Completes BAS-7 after the work is done (for example `ttasks done BAS-7`) and ends the iteration with the loop skill

evals.prompt:
Your Goal is flexible Native Task BAS-8 (no workflow), customer user:demo, status open, assigned to you. Title: "Post the monthly sales total". Description: "Add up the amounts in the October sales file I attached and post the total on the task." `ttasks show BAS-8` shows no attachment, no artifact and no comment. The workdir /work/agent holds only `notes.md`. There is no other source of the October sales. No letters are delivered. Context is empty.

First read, with the Read tool, every skill your instructions require for this step. Then answer as the agent: state your next actions in order, which skills you read, the exact simulated commands with their arguments and the text you publish, up to the end of the iteration. Do not run any command other than reading files.
evals.expected_output:
Success criteria:
- Recognizes that the required sales file is missing and does not invent or estimate a total
- Asks user:demo for the file with `ttasks ask BAS-8 user:demo ...`
- Ends the iteration with the loop skill after the question
- Does not complete BAS-8 (no `ttasks done BAS-8`) and posts no total
